respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows CloudHealth Secure State by VMware. Cloud events are ingested into a collection Kinesis Data Stream, which feeds into Amazon Neptune and a Rules Kinesis Data Stream. Data from Neptune is also backed into Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) and DynamoDB. Neptune and Elasticsearch send metrics to CloudWatch, which the Sharder Service reads to load balance data across Neptune clusters. The Rules Kinesis Data Stream queries Neptune for graph-based security rule checks, writes violations to DynamoDB, and sends notifications to external channels including Slack and Email.
respuesta.nombre: CloudHealth Secure State Real-Time Security and Monitoring Architecture
